437/// [`cp437_DOSLatinUS`](http://www.unicode.org/Public/MAPPINGS/VENDORS/MICSFT/PC/CP437.TXT) as provided by the Unicode Consortium.
438/// 
439/// Contains control characters in the `'\x00'..'\x20'` area.
440/// 
441/// The decode table is additionally enriched from the the [variant table](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Code_page_437#Notes) on Wikipedia.
442/// 
443/// # Examples
444/// 
445/// Decoding:
446/// 
447/// ```rust
448/// # use codepage_437::CP437_CONTROL;
449/// assert_eq!(CP437_CONTROL.decode(0x41), 'A');
450/// assert_eq!(CP437_CONTROL.decode(0x91), 'æ');  // LATIN SMALL LIGATURE AE
451/// ```
452/// 
453/// Encoding:
454/// 
455/// ```rust
456/// # use codepage_437::CP437_CONTROL;
457/// assert_eq!(CP437_CONTROL.encode('A'), Some(0x41));
458/// assert_eq!(CP437_CONTROL.encode('æ'), Some(0x91));  // LATIN SMALL LIGATURE AE
459/// 
460/// assert_eq!(CP437_CONTROL.encode('ź'), None);        // LATIN SMALL LETTER Z WITH ACUTE
461/// ```
462pub static CP437_CONTROL: Cp437Dialect = CP437_CONTROL_INIT;
463
464
465// dialect-specs/cp437_control end

473#[inline(always)]
474fn cp437_wingdings_cp437_overlaps(b: u8) -> bool {
475    b == 0 || (b > 0x1F && b < 0x7F)
476}
477
478#[inline(always)]
479fn cp437_wingdings_unicode_overlaps(c: char) -> bool {
480    c == '\u{00}' || (c > '\u{1F}' && c < '\u{7F}')
481}

936/// cp437 [with wingdings](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Code_page_437#Character_set), as seen on Wikipedia.
937/// 
938/// Contains wingdings in the `'\x00'..'\x20'` area.
939/// 
940/// The decode table is additionally enriched from the the [variant table](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Code_page_437#Notes).
941/// 
942/// # Examples
943/// 
944/// Decoding:
945/// 
946/// ```rust
947/// # use codepage_437::CP437_WINGDINGS;
948/// assert_eq!(CP437_WINGDINGS.decode(0x41), 'A');
949/// assert_eq!(CP437_WINGDINGS.decode(0x02), '☻');  // BLACK SMILING FACE
950/// ```
951/// 
952/// Encoding:
953/// 
954/// ```rust
955/// # use codepage_437::CP437_WINGDINGS;
956/// assert_eq!(CP437_WINGDINGS.encode('A'), Some(0x41));
957/// assert_eq!(CP437_WINGDINGS.encode('☻'), Some(0x02));  // BLACK SMILING FACE
958/// 
959/// assert_eq!(CP437_WINGDINGS.encode('ź'), None);        // LATIN SMALL LETTER Z WITH ACUTE
960/// ```
961pub static CP437_WINGDINGS: Cp437Dialect = CP437_WINGDINGS_INIT;
962
963
964// dialect-specs/cp437_wingdings end
